text: TheMechanical Design-Manufacturing and Automationmajor was developedfrom themajor ofForest Lumbering Engineering,and started to recruit students with its new name since 2003. Through years of construction and development, it isbecomingone of the majorswithmost solid educational foundation, and forming characteristicsin personnel training, scientific research, and discipline construction. Talents cultivated have made important contributions to the development of agro-forestry equipment R&D in Zhejiang province and across the country.Themajorhas been entitled asSchoolLevelKeyMajor,ProvincialLevelKeyMajoras well asProvincial Characteristic Specialty and Key Major.It hasdeveloped advantagesintalent cultivationin the fields of Electron-mechanicalintegration technology and Intelligent agro-forestry equipment design.The mechanical engineering disciplinary areas emphasized are design, manufacturing, optimization, dynamic systems and control, materials processing and mechanics inagro-forestryindustry.The mechanical engineering curriculum at Zhejiang A&F University is dedicated to preparing students for productive careers in a wide range of industries, include agricultural/engineering equipment, manufacturing, production design, teaching and technical management in the province, nation and around the world, and has the following objectives:1.Graduates will have utilized a foundation in engineering and science to improve lives and livelihoods through a successful career in mechanical engineering or other fields.2. Graduates will have become effective collaborators and innovators, leading or participating in efforts to address social, technical and business challenges.3. Graduates will have engaged in life-long learning and professional development through self-learning, continuing education or graduate and professional studies.4. Graduates will have great professional ethics and accomplishments, and have the will and ability to serve the society.5.Graduates will havebuiltinternationalhorizon,have good knowledge of Chinese politics, economy and culture, could positively promote the friendly communication and cooperation between China and their home country.
